name: Strip Steak with Spicy Asian-Style Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Cashews

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 lb Brussels sprouts
2 limes
2 red chili peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise; transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt, and stir to coat. Spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until Brussels sprouts are golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a small bowl.

Juice limes into the bowl with the shallot and garlic. Add soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar, then stir to combine the dressing. Transfer half of the dressing to a medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining dressing for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp fish sauce
2 tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, thinly slice chili peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the medium bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the bowl.
Add roasted Brussels sprouts to the bowl and stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Divide steak and Brussels sprouts between plates. Serve with reserved dressing for dipping steak and enjoy!
